properties.name: The v0.47.1 cut moved the version string in `reflow2.toml` from 0.47.0 to 0.47.1. Nothing this manifest DESCRIBES behaves differently — the dependency set is byte-for-byte what it was, and the design meaning of a cut lives in the Release and its epoch rather than in a version string. Accepted BEFORE `release_includes_all` deliberately: the manifest freezes each artifact's current checksum, so freezing first would record that v0.47.1 shipped the pre-bump file.
